# MaineDelivery

MaineDelivery is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. MaineDelivery offers final mile, home delivery, and logistics services to Maine's Coast, the Western Mountains, North Woods, & Aroostook County. MaineDelivery employs 2 people (-33.3% YoY, -1 person). Headquartered in Bangor, Maine, United States.

## About

We offer final mile and home delivery solutions that are reliable, affordable and we know Maine. When we deliver to your customer’s home, your brand’s image is our #1 priority. Our drivers are uniformed professionals. Our equipment and vehicles are kept in great condition and we are committed to making sure your customer’s buying experience is an exceptional one and that their expectations are always exceeded.
